name: axell/form-submission-notification
title: Atelier Form Notification
description: A success or error message shown after the application form is submitted via REST. Starts hidden; assets/js/frontend.js toggles it visible based on the fetch() result — see this plugin's CLAUDE.md for why this differs from Gutenberg's removed core/form-submission-notification block (which relied on a full-page reload + ?wp-form-result= GET param).
